input.quote: 13. NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES. Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services, without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: We reviewed the full agreement (preamble, §§ 1-7 and the numbered clauses 8-19) for any covenant limiting Clear Capital's business lines, products or fields of use. There is no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding us: the only restrictive covenant is the mutual employee non-solicitation in clause 13, which is reciprocal, term-plus-one-year and confined to personnel involved in the Services, and therefore outside the scope of this rule. The only other "Company shall not" language, in § 4(b)(ii) (p0020), bars resale or unrelated use of Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials and administrative records — an IP licence-scope limit on Contractor's property, not a restraint on our business, and it is mitigated by the perpetual, sublicensable licence to Contractor's Information for our business operations in § 4(c). Section 4(b) (p0019) likewise runs the other way, preserving Contractor's freedom to serve other clients rather than restricting us. No redline required.
